Application Data.NAME: John's Military Surplus
Application Data.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: Jane Doe, Store Manager, 123 Main St, Suite 100, Anytown, USA 12345-6789, (555) 123-4567
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: John's Military Surplus specializes in the retail sale of military-themed apparel, outdoor gear, and survival supplies. Our operations focus on providing customers with high-quality, legally sourced military surplus items, as well as a wide range of tactical equipment and accessories suitable for outdoor enthusiasts and collectors. We are committed to adhering to all federal regulations regarding the sourcing and sale of surplus items, ensuring our inventory meets compliance standards while delivering exceptional value to our customers. Our knowledgeable staff is dedicated to assisting shoppers with product selection and providing expert advice on military and outdoor gear.
